name: ZSO_SHARE_SIGNALS
description: This table is used to collect different categories of signals which are saved to record the act of viewing or sharing a document or a document page, or adding one of those objects to a users cart.

columns.name: SHARE_SIGNALS_ID
columns.description: ID column: the uniquely identifying surrogate key value

columns.name: SHARE_DOC_ID
columns.description: Document for which the signal has been generated

columns.name: SHARE_DOC_REVISION
columns.description: Document Revision for which the signal has been generated, if appropriate.  Document Versions are stored in WebCenter Content (UCM).

columns.name: PAGE_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Document Page (possibly within a Document Revision) for which the signal has been generated, if appropriate.

columns.name: CONTENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: The Content Id (in WebCenter Content) for which the signal was generated (may be either a Document or Document Page id, depending on the type of signal).

columns.name: SIGNAL_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: The Signal Category to which the signal belongs.  Initial available values are 'USE', 'VIEW' and 'SHARE'.

columns.name: SIGNAL_SUBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The specific type of signal, effectively a discriminator for interpreting the SIGNAL_SUBJECT_IDENTIFIER value.

columns.name: SIGNAL_SUBJECT_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The ID of the associated object specific to this kind of signal. Polymorphic value that may represent the ID for a Business Object for which the document signal is being generated (where the destination join is a NUMBER(18) ID or a VARCHAR2(64) value), e.g. Opportunity ID, Customer ID; or a Name (in the case of an OSN Discussion); or a URL (for an external/prospect share).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The party id of the user initiating the signal event.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
